phrases.text: Things we shout across the room get lost.
The whiteboard gets wiped, and the chat scrolls away.
Taskboard fixes that.
It's our team's shared to-do list.
One list, the same for everyone, and nothing gets wiped.
Open it in your browser, on your laptop or your phone.
There's no account and no login. Everyone can do everything.
When something comes up, write it down.
Type it into the one field, and press Add task.
New tasks land at the top.
Finished something? Tick it off.
It's struck through and moves below the open tasks, so everyone knows it's done.
Your teammates add tasks from their own phones and laptops.
The page doesn't update by itself, so reload it to see the latest.
Delete is for mistakes, like a task that got added twice.
It's gone for everyone, right away, and there's no undo.
Taskboard is simple on purpose.
No due dates, no assignees, no notifications.
Just the list.
So, write it down, and tick it off.
That's Taskboard.
